requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-2464-3220-3249--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-2464-3220-3249--52.notablePrerequisites: Song of Freyalise's first or second chapter ability has triggered this turn.
728-2464-3220-3249--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Song of Freyalise by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Golgari Germination triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

3175-6495-7424.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Changing Loyalty triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Changing Loyalty from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
3175-6495-7424.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

348-443-1152-4867-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-443-1152-4867-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Cormela from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Cormela and any creature not part of the combo.
When Cormela dies, it and Magus of the Bridge triggers.
Resolve the Cormela trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

2292-4276-5088-7443-7537.easyPrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
2292-4276-5088-7443-7537.notablePrerequisites:
You control eight or more lands.
Any one opponent cannot block and kill Emeritus of Abundance this turn.
2292-4276-5088-7443-7537.description:
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting any card besides the actual Regrowth.
Pyromancer's Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning that card from your graveyard to your hand.
Declare Emeritus of Abundance as an attacker.
When Emeritus of Abundance attacks, it triggers, becoming prepared.
During your second main phase, cast a copy of Regrowth by paying {1}{G}, targeting the actual Regrowth card.
Pyromancer Ascension's first ability triggers, allowing you to put a quest counter on it.
Resolve the copy of Regrowth, returning Regrowth from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Turnabout by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Turnabout.
Resolve a copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Emeritus of Abundance, producing that card's result.
Cast the card Regrowth from your hand by paying {1}{G}, targeting Emeritus of Abundance.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Regrowth and allowing you to target Turnabout with the copy.
Resolve both copies of Regrowth, returning Emeritus of Abundance and Turnabout from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Turnabout by paying its mana cost.
Pyromancer Ascension's second ability triggers, copying Turnabout.
Resolve a copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Resolve the remaining copy of Turnabout, untapping lands you control.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding mana.
Cast Emeritus of Abundance by paying {2}{G}.
Cast a copy of Regrowth from exile by paying {1}{G}, targeting Turnabout.
Both of Pyromancer Ascension's abilities trigger.
In response, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Emeritus of Ideation, producing that card's result.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's first abiliity, putting a redundant quest counter on it if desired.
Resolve Pyromancer Ascension's second ability, copying Regrowth and targeting Emeritus of Abundance with the copy.
Repeat from step 18.

240-997-4452.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies as an Egg due to Rukarumel, Atla triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat as desired / able.
240-997-4452.notes: The combo can continue as long as there are creature cards in your library.

229-5660-7388.description:
Cast Endless One by paying {0}.
Endless One enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Rocksteady triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Endless One from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

147-3967-7335.description:
Cast Pain 101 by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Pain 101, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Pain 101.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Yahenni abilities from step 5.

1430-5282-7149.description:
Cast Mirror Image by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Mirror Image into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Mirror Image dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Newt, gaining its abilities.
When Mirror Image enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Mirror Image leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Mirror Image from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

5670-6705-6720.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
5670-6705-6720.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

413-1003-4053-6989.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
When Phyrexian Walker enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

2292-4053-4336-6989.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

107-4050-6972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Ambitious Aetherborn.
When Ambitious Aetherborn dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Ambitious Aetherborn enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2604-3532-4997-5078.notablePrerequisites: You control another Knight and/or Merfolk.
2604-3532-4997-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Vodalian Wave-Knight triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other Knight and/or Merfolk you control.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

2173-3652-5220-5226.description:
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing Ornithopter
When Ornithopter dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Ornithopter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Lithatog ability.
Cast Ornithopter from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

4050-5220-6537-6900.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Tarpan.
When Tarpan dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tarpan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Tarpan trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Cast Tarpan from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

3755-5051-5078-6650.easyPrerequisites: The Lunar Whale has attacked this turn.
3755-5051-5078-6650.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

3525-4289-6857.description:
Activate Kragma Butcher by tapping it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Kragma Butcher.
Kragma Butcher triggers, giving it +2/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 4 or greater

1127-3152-5922.description:
Activate Helga by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W} that can only be spent to cast creature spells with mana value 4 or greater or with {X} in their mana cost.
Cast Blinking Spirit by paying {3}{W}.
Helga and Chakram Retriever trigger.
Resolve the Helga trigger, causing you to draw a card, gain 1 life, and put a +1/+1 counter on Helga.
Resolve the Chakram Retriever trigger, causing you to untap Helga.
Activate Blinking Spirit by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Oracle of Mul Daya

573-5449-5702-6664.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn
573-5449-5702-6664.description:
Play Gruul Turf. When it enters untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel, Gruul Turf and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Resolve the Gruul Turf trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Oracle of Mul Daya.
Because of the additional Oracle of Mul Daya token, you can play an additional land this turn. 
Repeat.

560-2034-4506-4593.description:
Activate Mite Overseer by paying {3}{W/P}, creating two creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter the battlefield, Auriok Champion triggers twice, causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.
560-2034-4506-4593.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the creature tokens

1350-2499-6470.description:
Cast Iridescent Tiger by paying {4}{R}.
When Iridescent Tiger enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Meticulous Excavation by paying {2}{W}, returning Iridescent Tiger from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2324-5670-6291.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
2324-5670-6291.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Proper Burial triggers, causing you to gain life equal to the sacrificed creature's toughness.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
Repeat.

969-2105-3204-6188.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
969-2105-3204-6188.description:
Declare either Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant from the battlefield, and then returning Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1069-3156-4763-5553.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more artifacts including an Equipment.
1069-3156-4763-5553.description:
Activate an Equipment's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Greedy Freebooter.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk by sacrificing Greedy Freebooter, targeting Koll.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Greedy Freebooter trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Koll.
Cast Greedy Freebooter by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1545-3263-4078-4242-5256.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 4.
1545-3263-4078-4242-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Su-Chi.
When Su-Chi dies, it triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Su-Chi's power.
Activate Chainer by paying {3} and 3 life, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Su-Chi enters the battlefield, Trostani triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Su-Chi's toughness.
Repeat.

1636-2857-3388.notablePrerequisites:
Adarkar Valkyrie does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one legendary creature.
1636-2857-3388.description:
Activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting any legendary creature you control.
Cast Moritte of the Frost by paying {2}{G}{U}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of the legendary creature targeted in step 1.
Put the legendary creature into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting Moritte of the Frost.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 4, returning the legendary creature to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Put Moritte of the Frost into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Adarkar Valkyrie and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Holding priority, activate Adarkar Valkyrie by tapping it, targeting the legendary creature.
Resolve the Adarkar Valkyrie trigger from step 9, returning Moritte of the Frost to the battlefield from your graveyard as a copy of the legendary creature.
Repeat from step 3.

1806-2034-2382-4314.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Pawn of Ulamog and Mimic Vat trigger.
Resolve the Pawn of Ulamog trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Mimic Vat trigger, exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.

2335-3386-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Splinter Twin and Nurturing Presence attached to Barrenton Medic.
Barrenton Medic does not have summoning sickness.
2335-3386-4702.description:
Activate Barrenton Medic by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
When the Barrenton Medic token enters the battlefield, the nontoken Barrenton Medic triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Barrenton Medic by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Repeat.

728-1656-2380.notablePrerequisites: Necrotic Ooze does not have summoning sickness.
728-1656-2380.description:
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Bloodline Keeper's first ability by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Vampire creature token.
Activate Necrotic Ooze using Grimgrin's ability by sacrificing the Vampire, untapping Necrotic Ooze and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

229-1456-5220.description:
Cast Endless One either from your hand or from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Endless One enters the battlefield and dies as a state-based action due to having zero toughness.
Mortuary triggers, putting Endless One on top of your library from your graveyard.
Repeat.

548-3212-4872-5261.description:
During the end step before your turn, activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Brainstorm without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Brainstorm, causing you to draw three cards and put Time Warp and another card on top of your library, ensuring Time Warp is the topmost card.
Move to your turn, drawing and revealing Time Warp during your draw step.
God-Eternal Kefnet's first ability triggers, causing you to pay {1}{U}{U} to cast a copy of Time Warp.
Resolve the copy of Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Brainstorm without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

152-2445-5296.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Workhorse with haste that enters the battlefield with eight +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate the Workhorse token seven times by removing seven +1/+1 counters from it, adding seven {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead copy any artifact you control.

1124-1367-1887-3326-5131.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast a Planeswalker spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1124-1367-1887-3326-5131.description:
Cast Kasmina from your graveyard by paying {1}{U}{G}.
Kasmina enters the battlefield with four loyalty counters due to Vorinclex.
Activate The Chain Veil by paying {4} and tapping it, allowing you an additional activation of each of your planeswalkers' loyalty abilities this turn.
Activate Kasmina's first loyalty ability by putting four loyalty counters on it due to Vorinclex, causing you to scry 1.
Activate Kasmina's third loyalty ability by removing eight loyalty counters from it.
Kasmina dies as a state-based action due to having zero loyalty.
Resolve the Kasmina ability, causing you to search for library for Nexus of Fate, exile it, then cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Nexus of Fate, allowing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Repeat each turn.

2713-2816-4360.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Greenweaver Druid.
Greenweaver Druid does not have summoning sickness.
2713-2816-4360.description:
Activate Greenweaver Druid by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Greenweaver Druid by paying {1} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

413-764-1069-2018.description:
Pay {0} to equip Luminous Broodmoth with Colossus Hammer.
Tap Blasting Station, sacrificing Luminous Broodmoth to deal 1 damage to any target.
Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning itself to the battlefield with a flying counter.
Blasting Station triggers, untapping.
Repeat.
